title: Apple WWDC
metaDescription: Apple WWDC: verified dates, venue and practical planning context for this technology event.

overview.about: Apple's Worldwide Developers Conference (WWDC) is the company's flagship event for software developers, held each June. It is where Apple reveals the next versions of iOS, macOS and its other platforms, setting the direction for its entire ecosystem for the year ahead.
overview.nextEvent: The next WWDC is held in June, centred on Apple Park in Cupertino and streamed worldwide. The keynote unveils Apple's new operating systems and developer tools, followed by a week of technical sessions.

@graph.name: Apple WWDC
@graph.description: WWDC is Apple’s annual forum for the software platforms behind the iPhone, Mac, iPad, Apple Watch and Apple TV. Its 2026 programme paired an online week of developer sessions with a limited in-person special event at Apple Park for Apple Developer Program members. Cupertino is relevant only for that on-site gathering; most sessions, videos and documentation are published through Apple’s developer channels.
